Adrenalina.name: Adrenaline
Adrenalina.effect: 1 Combat Action: restores 3 Life Circles. Post-combat crash: -1 Combat Action and -1 Movement until resting (reaching 0 actions causes cardiac arrest).

Álcool.name: Alcohol
Álcool.effect: Antiseptic used to clean wounds, prevent infections, or serve as flammable fuel.

Arsênico.name: Arsenic
Arsênico.effect: Assists in treating poisons and venoms (toxic in high doses).

Babosa.name: Aloe Vera (Babosa)
Babosa.effect: Topical herb used to relieve muscle pain, minor burns, and sanitize wounds.

Boldo.name: Boldo
Boldo.effect: Infusion used to treat gastric distress, headaches, and heatstroke effects.

Cavalinha.name: Horsetail (Cavalinha)
Cavalinha.effect: Purgative infusion used to detoxify poisons and treat digestive infections.

Cânfora.name: Camphor (Cânfora)
Cânfora.effect: Combat use (1 Combat Action): immediately restores 1 Pain Circle.

Erva-doce.name: Aniseed (Erva-doce)
Erva-doce.effect: Digestive infusion for relieving cramps and intestinal discomfort.

Folha de Salgueiro.name: Willow Leaf
Folha de Salgueiro.effect: Natural analgesic and antipyretic for high fever and headaches.

Gengibre.name: Ginger
Gengibre.effect: Infusion used to treat coughs, colds, and fever.

Laxante.name: Laxative
Laxante.effect: Liquid compound for relieving constipation and food poisoning.

Mil-folhas.name: Yarrow (Mil-folhas)
Mil-folhas.effect: Decongestant infusion to clear respiratory pathways.

Morfina.name: Morphine
Morfina.effect: Potent anesthetic for surgical procedures; induces deep sleep and carries addiction risk.

Pomada de Cavalo.name: Horse Ointment
Pomada de Cavalo.effect: Applied to the mount during rest: restores +3 additional Life Circles to the animal.

Tônico Milagroso.name: Miracle Tonic
Tônico Milagroso.effect: Requires a Card Luck Draw: Black Card immediately restores 3 Pain Circles; Red Card applies the Poisoned condition.

Unguento.name: Ointment (Unguento)
Unguento.effect: Applied during rest: restores +1 additional Life Circle.

Xarope de Tosse.name: Cough Syrup
Xarope de Tosse.effect: Auxiliary medicine for treating coughs and pulmonary ailments.
